thesis: AbbVie — pharma major with growing immunology franchise (Skyrizi + Rinvoq more than offsetting the Humira patent cliff), plus oncology, neuroscience and aesthetics. Durable dividend grower. ConocoPhillips — best-in-class large-cap E&P with the most unanimous Wall Street buy support among the majors (17 buys). Low-cost, diversified portfolio; $12B 2026 capex with $1B cost-reduction target; avg analyst PT ~$144 (~19% upside). Bought to fill an empty Energy sector amid an active oil tailwind (US-Iran strikes, Strait of Hormuz risk) and energy's YTD leadership (XLE +26-27%). Also an inflation hedge with CPI back above 4%. Risk: a genuine US-Iran de-escalation softening crude. Hold weeks-months. Sector: Energy.
